rejected_previous_issuer.reason: The identity is shared by every repository Actions workflow and therefore is not unique to the trusted verifier.
rejected_previous_issuer.same_name_forgery_model: A task-branch workflow/job named Pantheon canonical reviewer attestation, or any repository Actions job with checks:write, would still be emitted as app id 15368 and could satisfy the previous plan without a reviewer envelope.

replacement_contract.credential_boundary: installation token minted outside repository Actions and shared owner runtime
replacement_contract.next_gate: Human/Ops provisions the external App and verifier, then supplies a read-only successful canary check-run JSON to protection-plan.

negative_regressions.meaning: Protection-plan generation fails closed when the canary App is id 15368/slug github-actions.
A same-name success from app id 15368 fails plan-bound protection readback when the required identity is the dedicated external App.
A custom App owned by the shared repository account is not accepted as an external trust boundary.
The isolated attestation audit workflow has no checks:write permission, status write permission, or check-runs API call.
The mainline generic lifecycle status remains present under its distinct name and cannot be confused with the external-App-pinned attestation.
